title: Trade Alpha Attribution - Return Attribution Report
conclusion: Current Trade does not underperform the matched equal-capital Buy & Hold benchmark in the frozen production window. The leading diagnosed opportunity is winner-lifecycle truncation and repeated exit/re-entry, with AB5 account-risk-budget showing the strongest direct causal opportunity cost.

buy_quality.interpretation: Opportunity discovery inside the current production 17 is not the leading diagnosed weakness.

ab5_direct_counterfactual.scope: isolates existing AB5 account-risk-budget mechanism only; other risk logic remains active

decision: Preserve Trade risk identification, causal execution, account/risk continuity and proven high-quality entry capability.
Prioritize winner-lifecycle and AB5 risk/return efficiency research before broad opportunity-discovery expansion.
Do not modify production behavior in this attribution stage.
limitations: Forward returns are descriptive and overlapping; they cannot be summed as additive portfolio alpha loss.
Trade vs Buy & Hold is a matched capability comparison, not a pure causal risk-rule decomposition.
